press_references.value: Peptone Establishes Strategic Partnership with Evotec to Selectively Target Intrinsically Disordered Proteins (IDPs) and Advance Small-Molecule Therapeutics at Scale

partnership_announcements.description: Peptone, a biotechnology company focused on therapeutics targeting intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs), has established a strategic partnership with Evotec, a life science company specializing in drug discovery and development. The collaboration aims to accelerate and scale the creation of small molecule IDP-targeted treatments by combining Peptone's proprietary HDX-MS platform and structural insights with Evotec's drug discovery expertise and technology platforms. The partnership will focus on high-value IDP targets, particularly in oncology and immunology, and is expected to enable rapid development of novel therapeutic solutions.

research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Peptone is engaged in the development of engineered cytokines and polypeptide structures, utilizing artificial neural network machine learning protocols and molecular dynamics simulations, as described in 'Engineered cytokines and uses thereof.' The company also focuses on in silico generation and spatio-temporal determination of polypeptide structures, including methods for predicting epitopes or binding surfaces, as outlined in 'Spacio-temporal determination of polypeptide structure.' These efforts target novel therapeutics against intrinsically disordered proteins.
